case_title: PACIFIC GAS AND ELECTRIC COMPANY VS KOLL CONSTRUCTION

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,500.00 FILED BY PACIFIC GAS AND ELECTRIC COMPANY AS TO DEFENDANT KOLL CONSTRUCTION ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-21-1993 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 05
